name: St. Charles Parish, LA
findings: St. Charles Parish has 108 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Charles Parish has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in St. Charles Parish list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in St. Charles Parish list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
